purpose: Independent learning exercise requested by María. Isolated copies only; no product mutation.

exercises.question: Can a test that proves reticle recognition + keyboard route pass while the natural mouse action is absent?
exercises.old_oracle: Recognition succeeds when the belt enters the central recognition region and Enter is used.
exercises.broad_promise_violated: A person can point/select the visible sky directly with the mouse/touch when that is the spontaneous gesture.
exercises.improved_oracle: Direct-point task oracle: click/tap on a visible target under current pan/zoom must select/localize without camera jump; drag remains pan.

exercises.question: Can horizontal scrollWidth pass while content is visibly clipped at 200% text?
exercises.broad_promise_violated: 200% text has no loss of content.
exercises.improved_oracle: REFLOW_INTERNAL_CLIP_ORACLE: horizontal document fit + visible descendants with overflow hidden/clip must have scrollHeight<=clientHeight and scrollWidth<=clientWidth.

exercises.question: Can a large pixel-difference score pass while the subject does not read as swimming?
exercises.broad_promise_violated: The animal visibly swims/moves through the scene rather than only flickering/deforming.
exercises.improved_oracle: Temporal-coherence oracle: require meaningful centroid/pose trajectory over time plus bounded deformation; supplement with perceptual review.

exercises.question: Can logical z=3 pass while height is not represented visually?
exercises.broad_promise_violated: The player/world visibly communicates vertical ascent/volume.
exercises.improved_oracle: SPATIAL_Z_VISIBILITY_ORACLE: same x/y across levels must produce defined projected displacement/occlusion or equivalent visible depth cue.

improved_oracles.catches: Internal vertical/horizontal clipping that document-level scrollWidth misses.
Logical altitude/state changes that have no visible spatial consequence.
